scene: Uprooting the radish reveals a rooftop transit hub!
picture: Flat side view. At the far left, a red street tram waits on tracks. The player stands centre-left holding a giant purple radish under one arm, with her red umbrella in hand. At centre, stairs lead down into a glowing subway entrance. On the right, a blue ferry floats beside a dock.
shown: A red street tram waiting on elevated tracks at the far left
A blue harbour ferry tied to a roof dock on the right
A lit subway entrance with stairs descending at the centre

variants.scene: Your giant radish is harvested, uncovering a bustling rooftop station beneath the twilight.
While you hum {tune}, sunset colors glow over three strange ways out.
Holding the giant radish, you discover a lively garden dock high above streets.
